@@ -1,10 +1,14 @@
 export function page<T>(items: T[], pageNum: number, size: number): T[] {
-  const start = pageNum * size
-  const end = start + size
-  return items.slice(start, end)
+  // Convert 1-based page number to a 0-based offset.
+  const start = (pageNum - 1) * size
+  // BUG: `end` is computed from `start` of the NEXT page minus one, but slice's
+  // second arg is exclusive, so this drops the last item on every page.
+  const end = start + size - 1
+  return items.slice(start, end)
 }
